title: Kasa Academy learning pathway
description: Eight stages from first program to independent projects. Availability is explicit; prerequisites are recommendations, not account-based access restrictions.

stages.title: Computing foundations
outcomes: Explain instructions and algorithms using everyday examples
Read, predict and run first Kasa programs
stages.assessment: Complete chapter practice and explain a small program
stages.videoPolicy: Existing beginner chapters are readable without requiring recordings

stages.title: Kasa language fundamentals
outcomes: Use Kasa variables, decisions, loops, functions and lists
Debug common syntax and type errors
stages.assessment: Trace a working program and correct two deliberate mistakes
stages.videoPolicy: Text-first chapters remain usable without video

stages.title: Problem solving and algorithms
outcomes: Explain searching, sorting and algorithmic complexity
stages.assessment: Implement and explain a basic search or sorting task
stages.videoPolicy: Five text-first algorithm lessons are available as standalone editorial pages; no CMS video or transcript records are overwritten.

stages.title: Data structures and data processing
outcomes: Model nested lists and validate inputs
Compute descriptive measures with core Kasa
stages.videoPolicy: Experimental tables and typed records taught as concepts, not builtins

stages.title: Applied Kasa programming
outcomes: Compute receipts, marks and inventory decisions
Explain the assumptions and limitations of each program
stages.assessment: Finish the five practice labs and explain output checks
stages.videoPolicy: Five applied labs are available as editorial pages; no CMS lesson videos or transcripts are moved or replaced.

stages.title: Modules and reusable programs
outcomes: Distinguish core code from opt-in Studio JS imports
Use only pinned module exports in supported environments
stages.assessment: Run one Studio module exercise and explain native limitations
stages.videoPolicy: Do not advertise unsupported imports or general-purpose package loading

stages.title: Software development practices
outcomes: Write tests and communicate expected program behavior
stages.assessment: Submit an explained test plan and revision history
stages.videoPolicy: Future content requires reviewed, published CMS video associations

stages.title: Independent projects and portfolio
outcomes: Design a complete Kasa project from a real problem
stages.assessment: Complete a project and explain its evidence
stages.videoPolicy: Existing project exercises do not require videos
